functions.name: remPio2f
functions.notes: Single-precision argument reduction rem_pio2f. Fast path uses two-term f64 reduction; Inf/NaN stores x-x and returns 0; large path scales into [2^23,2^24) and delegates to unrecovered Payne-Hanek 285 with (scaled, out, exponent, 1, 0). Mirrors the 16-byte frame and restores the stack pointer.

validation.comparison: 590 float bit patterns span zero, subnormals, exponent boundaries, the 1305022426 threshold, Inf/NaN and the Payne-Hanek range. Each compares result, output f64, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Out-of-range p1 pointers are not enumerated.
Ledger: 257 server bodies recovered and 477 remain machine code.
